# delay.notes

> A personal notebook of an undergraduate archaeology student in China.

## About

delay.notes is a personal knowledge-sharing site maintained by a single author
currently studying archaeology at university in China. The site is written
primarily in Chinese and covers coursework, readings, and reflections across
archaeology, history, philosophy, anthropology, and related humanities fields.

Content is continuously updated and is intended for reference only.
The site has been running since 2022.

## Content

Notes are the sole output of the site author. They are not collaborative or
crowd-sourced. Entries typically follow the structure of university courses or
books, and may include reading notes, lecture summaries, and personal
annotations. Content spans Chinese and world archaeology, classical Chinese
thought, Western philosophy, anthropology, and literary history, among other
subjects.

## Audience & Interaction

The site is publicly readable. Visitors may register an account to leave
comments on notes. A question box (留言提问功能) is available for anyone to
submit questions to the author anonymously or with attribution; the author
responds publicly on the same page.

## Rights

Content is the intellectual property of the site author.
Non-commercial reproduction is permitted with attribution.
Commercial use and unauthorized reproduction are prohibited.
